shadows.name: card-light
shadows.purpose: 浅色主题的统一卡片阴影。

shadows.name: card-dark
shadows.purpose: 深色主题的统一卡片阴影。

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: 按钮颜色及边框过渡；输入框使用相同持续时间。

motion.name: mobile-sidebar-transition
motion.purpose: 手机导航抽屉；减少动效设置下禁用。

components.name: 主按钮
components.css: .ds-button-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:36px;padding:7px 13px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font:500 13px/1.5 "Avenir Next", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;transition:background .18s,border-color .18s;color:#fff;background:var(--primary,#078747);}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:var(--primary-hover,#056e39);}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#078747);outline-offset:3px}.ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}:host-context([data-theme="dark"]) .ds-button-primary{color:#132b1b}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: 次按钮
components.css: .ds-button-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:36px;padding:7px 13px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font:500 13px/1.5 "Avenir Next", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;transition:background .18s,border-color .18s;color:var(--ink,#303732);background:var(--card,#fff);border-color:var(--line,#e3e8e4);}.ds-button-secondary:hover{color:var(--primary,#078747);background:var(--primary-soft,#e8f6ed);border-color:var(--primary,#078747);}.ds-button-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#078747);outline-offset:3px}.ds-button-secondary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-secondary{transition:none}}

components.name: 危险按钮
components.css: .ds-button-danger{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;min-height:36px;padding:7px 13px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font:500 13px/1.5 "Avenir Next", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;transition:background .18s,border-color .18s;color:var(--red,#c53b3b);background:var(--card,#fff);border-color:var(--line,#e3e8e4);}.ds-button-danger:hover{background:var(--danger-soft,#fff0ef);border-color:var(--red,#c53b3b);}.ds-button-danger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#078747);outline-offset:3px}.ds-button-danger:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-danger{transition:none}}

components.name: 文本字段
components.description: 带有可见标签的原生输入框。
components.html: <label class="ds-field" for="ds-repository-url">仓库地址</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-repository-url" type="url" placeholder="请输入仓库地址">
components.css: .ds-field{display:block;color:var(--ink,#303732);font:500 13px/1.65 "Avenir Next", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;margin-bottom:7px}.ds-input{width:100%;min-height:42px;padding:9px 12px;color:var(--ink,#303732);background:var(--surface,#f8faf8);border:1px solid var(--line,#e3e8e4);border-radius:6px;caret-color:var(--primary,#078747);font:14px/1.65 "Avenir Next", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;transition:border-color .18s,background .18s}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#66726a);opacity:1}.ds-input:focus{background:var(--card,#fff);border-color:var(--primary,#078747);outline:2px solid var(--primary-soft,#e8f6ed);outline-offset:1px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-input{transition:none}}

components.name: 导航当前项
components.description: 带当前页语义的侧栏导航。
components.html: 概览仓库管理系统设置
components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;gap:5px;padding:22px 10px;background:var(--card,#fff);font:14px/1.65 "Avenir Next", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif}.ds-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 16px;color:var(--muted,#66726a);border-radius:6px;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a.ds-nav-current,.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--primary,#078747);background:var(--primary-soft,#e8f6ed)}.ds-nav a.ds-nav-current{font-weight:600}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary,#078747);outline-offset:3px}

components.html:

查看同步状态与事件。
components.css: .ds-card{background:var(--card,#fff);color:var(--ink,#303732);border-radius:var(--radius,10px);padding:24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow,0 3px 16px rgba(32,48,39,.06));font:14px/1.65 "Avenir Next", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif}.ds-card h2{margin:0 0 16px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600}.ds-card p{margin:0}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-card{padding:20px 16px}}
